title: SnapshotManifest
description: Provenance ledger for best-grade IR files promoted to the snapshots/ store. Mirrors deploy/manifest.json but for .ir.json files.

pages.description: Map of content_path to SnapshotIREntry. content_path is the canonical key (same as in deploy manifest).

majority_run_id.description: Run ID that contributed the most IR slots (cumulative) to this snapshot store. Its phase JSONs are written to phase_store/.

majority_run_ir_count.description: Cumulative IR slot count for the majority run (fast comparison value).

run_ir_counts.description: Cumulative IR slot count per run_id across all promotion calls. Used for correct majority tracking in backfill scenarios.

last_promotion.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last promotion operation.

promotion_count.description: Total number of promotion operations run against this manifest.

SnapshotIREntry.description: Record of one promoted IR file in the snapshots/ directory.

content_path.description: Canonical page identifier. Path invariant: snapshots_dir / (content_path + '.ir.json').

source_run_id.description: Run ID that produced this IR file.

grade.description: Quality grade of this IR at time of promotion.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the IR file bytes.

promoted_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this IR was promoted.
